# IPS4o

Unmodified headers from https://github.com/ips4o/ips4o, commit
`08a5b926ee65cef19139057c6bde02bb5542c1cb`.
BSD 2-Clause license in LICENSE and each header.

Optional large-person-group sorting backend. The pipeline's existing eight
workers sort independent person groups, using the library's sequential entry
point so the total worker count remains eight.
